subtitles.text: Transport, you're cleared in to Greyrock.
First one. They said it's been sealed nine years.
Still running, too. Guards, inmates, whoever was inside.
Four went in. Seven days, and nobody's called.
That's why we're here. There it is.
One more thing. A signal in the deep block, every twenty seconds. Source unknown.
Mask sealed, Reyes. I'm not carrying you back.
